name: react-nextjs
description: React or Next.js frontend (TypeScript, TanStack Query). Adds the react-frontend and nextjs-frontend skills, the react batch implementer, two stack rules, hook parameters, and a stack section for the profile. Use nextjs-frontend's skill for an App Router project; react-frontend otherwise. Both are included so a project only using one isn't missing the other if it changes later.
